Our Platform

Powered by Technology

ANS Growth Advisors Technology — proprietary tools built to automate finance operations, eliminate manual effort, and deliver repeatable, auditable workflows for high-volume businesses.

FP&A & MIS Automation
Automated MIS packs, budget vs actuals, unit economics and management reporting — with variance logic and commentary built in.
Multi-Source Reconciliation
Aggregator, POS, payment gateway, bank and ERP data reconciled at order level. Work that took days, done in minutes.
Automated COGS & Leakage Control
Automated tracking of cost of goods sold, pricing leakage, vendor variances and margin gaps — surfaced in real time before they hit the P&L.
Lease Automation Tool
Automates lease schedules, rental computations, escalation tracking and liability reporting — eliminating manual lease management across multiple properties.
Compliance Automation
Automated GST, TDS, PF and ESIC reconciliations with filing-ready outputs, deadline tracking and exception registers — keeping compliance on schedule.
Traceable Working Files
Every output maps to its source. Exception tabs, audit trails and finance-friendly Excel outputs with full source references.
